import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Combine id and text columns
train_texts = train_df["text"]
test_texts = test_df["text"]
train_ids = train_df["id"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Split training data into train/validation sets (80/20)
train_texts_split, val_texts_split, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_texts.values,
    train_df["author"].values,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["author"].values,
)

# Create TF-IDF features
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2))
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts_split)
X_val = vectorizer.transform(val_texts_split)
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_texts)

# Encode labels
label_encoder = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
y_train_encoded = np.array([label_encoder[l] for l in y_train])
y_val_encoded = np.array([label_encoder[l] for l in y_val])

# Train model
model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", multi_class="multinomial"
)
model.fit(X_train, y_train_encoded)


# Convert predictions back to class names for scoring
def encode_for_scoring(pred_probs):
    classes = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
    scored_rows = []
    for i, row in enumerate(pred_probs):
        for j, cls in enumerate(classes):
            if cls in ["EAP", "MWS", "HPL"]:
                scored_rows.append(row[j])
    return np.array(scored_rows).reshape(len(pred_probs), -1)


# Evaluate on validation set
val_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_encoded, val_pred_prob)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
test_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Format submission
class_labels = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
submission_data = []

for i, prob in enumerate(test_pred_prob):
    for j, label in enumerate(class_labels):
        submission_data.append({"id": test_ids[i], f"{label}": float(prob[j])})

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
